name: Hibiscus Tea
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated on SIBO protocols as it's naturally FODMAP-free and may have mild antimicrobial properties that could be beneficial.
preparationTips: Steep dried hibiscus petals in hot water for 5-10 minutes for optimal flavor
Can be enjoyed hot or cold - makes excellent iced tea
Add low-FODMAP sweeteners like stevia or maple syrup (1 tbsp max) if desired
Avoid adding high-FODMAP fruits like apple or pear for flavoring
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in vitamin C and antioxidants
Contains anthocyanins which give the deep red color
